summary: Completed Module 02 FIX: Implemented defense-in-depth against Log Injection / CRLF log forging
evidence: Identified log injection vulnerability: Unsanitized user strings containing newlines can deceive SIEM collectors and operators into reading forged events
Implemented CRLF escaping in logging formatter: Updated redact_text in apps/api/app/core/logging.py to explicitly replace '\r' and '\n' with literal escaped sequences
Enforced schema boundary validation: Pydantic LinkCreate rejects control characters (ASCII 0-31 including CR/LF) at API ingress
Verified defense: Logged malicious payload containing simulated fake admin login JSON; verified output remained on a single escaped line without splitting
